# Active Goals — ACE v2 Scientific Research & Successor Meta-Harness Program

## Mission Statement
Research, empirically measure, falsify, and build **ACE v2 (`/workspace/ace_v2/`)** — a successor cognitive meta-harness grounded in the **DeepSeek-Harness / Cordis paper (`arXiv 2608.25512`)** and our **340-paper Meta-Harness corpus (`/workspace/research_corpus/`)** that demonstrably beats **ACE v1** end-to-end on:
1. **Lowering Turns per Task** (`cost-of-pass` in steps & wall time)
2. **Maximizing KV Prefix Cache Hit Rate & Lowering Uncached Token Burn**
3. **Benchmark Rigor & Reliable Datasets** (Mode-3 non-editable gates, mutation-audited tests, 95% Beta credible intervals, paired McNemar $p$-values)
4. **Spatiotemporal Composability & Shared Infrastructure** (`Cordis` revertible effects + reactive coeffects + capability interception)
5. **Self-Auditing & Recursive Self-Improvement** (`ModularRSI` + `P5` split-A/split-B non-inferiority guard + tamper/contamination auditing)
- **Strict Non-Switchover Rule:** Build, test, and benchmark everything inside `/workspace/` and `/wiki/`. Do NOT switch over or kill the host ACE binary.

## Phase 1 — DeepSeek/Meta-Harness Literature Grounding & ACE v1 Empirical Forensics
- [x] **Milestone 1.1 — DeepSeek Cordis & Meta-Harness Corpus Synthesis (`/workspace/corpus_synthesizer.py`):** Write and run `/workspace/corpus_synthesizer.py` (`--selftest` exit 0) that parses all staged papers in `/workspace/research_corpus/` (`deepseek-harness-paper-digest-cordis-spatiotemporal.md`, `cordis-deepseek-harness-full.txt`, `v2-autopsy-completion-vs-substance-bug-the-real-find.md`, `counter-evidence-ledger-what-weakens-our-strongest-c.md`, `meta-harness-p3-paper-findings.md`, `meta-harness-audit-bugs.md`, `paper-modularrsi-modular-and-generalizable-recursive.md`) and outputs a structured machine-verifiable matrix of mechanisms, mathematical invariants, and counter-evidence bounds to `/workspace/literature_grounding.json`, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.
- [ ] **Milestone 1.2 — Ground-Truth v1 Telemetry & Mutation Audit (`/workspace/v1_forensics.py`):** Write and run `/workspace/v1_forensics.py` (`--selftest` exit 0) that (a) queries `/workspace/ace_v1_traces.db` (`6,360` `thought_traces`, `26,495` `telemetry_spans`) to compute exact era-by-era turns/cycle, KV cache hit %, uncached tokens/cycle, model-bounce cache losses, and no-op rates; AND (b) runs a `SWE-Mutation`-style mutation audit on ACE v1's existing `/workspace/drift_detector.py` and `/workspace/accept_phase15.py` to measure what % of planted realistic mutants v1's self-authored tests actually catch vs. miss (`completion-vs-substance` audit), saving all results to `/workspace/v1_forensics_report.json` and `notes/v1-forensics-and-literature.md` via `wiki_write`, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.

## Phase 2 — Reliable Benchmark Dataset & Mode-3 Non-Gameable Evaluation Harness
- [ ] **Milestone 2.1 — Calibrated Benchmark Dataset & Mutant Suite (`/workspace/ace_v2_dataset.py`):** Following `p3-paper-findings.md` (A1–A12, M1–M14) and `review-harness-bugs.md`, build `/workspace/ace_v2_dataset.py` (`--selftest` exit 0) containing a deterministic, stratified benchmark dataset (`/workspace/ace_v2_benchmark_tasks.json`) of `>= 24` tasks across 4 categories (1: real trace-replay routing/caching from `ace_v1_traces.db`, 2: multi-step code repair with both `fail_to_pass` and broader `pass_to_pass` regression checks, 3: AST context-localization tasks, 4: planted-mutant & tamper/contamination traps) split deterministically into **Split-A (dev/mining)** and **Split-B (held-out evaluation)**, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.
- [ ] **Milestone 2.2 — Mode-3 Hardened Scorer & Statistical Engine (`/workspace/ace_v2_scorer.py`):** Build `/workspace/ace_v2_scorer.py` (`--selftest` exit 0) implementing Mode-3 runner-enforced evaluation: automatic `drop_test_edits` hardening (`conftest.py`/test-tamper rejection), relative-path contamination auditing (`review-harness-bugs.md` #2), timeout `test_rc` tracking (#4), strict whole-task resolution (`f2p` all pass AND `p2p` zero broken), Bayesian 95% Beta credible intervals, exact paired McNemar test, 10,000-draw bootstrap CIs, and `cost-of-pass` (uncached tokens & turns per resolved task), then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.

## Phase 3 — Cordis Spatiotemporal Runtime & Shared Infrastructure
- [ ] **Milestone 3.1 — Cordis Revertible Effects & Reactive Coeffects Runtime (`/workspace/ace_v2_cordis.py`):** Implement the formal calculus from the DeepSeek-Harness / Cordis paper (`arXiv 2608.25512`) in `/workspace/ace_v2_cordis.py` (`--selftest` exit 0): (1) **Temporal Composability (`ctx.effect`)** where every file/state/context mutation registers an explicit LIFO inverse so failed or gate-rejected steps atomically roll back to exact initial state; (2) **Spatial Composability (`Reactive Coeffects`)** with static capability `inject` specs, `ctx.isolate`, and `ctx.intercept` throwing `UNDECLARED_ACCESS` / `INACTIVE_ACCESS`; and (3) **"Model-Visible Means Logged"** hash-chained event ledger with PROV-O provenance, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.

## Phase 4 — Lowering Turns & Maximizing KV Cache Efficiency (Controlled Ablations)
- [ ] **Milestone 4.1 — Experiment 1: AST Dependency-Cone Context Compiler & Sticky Bandit Router (`/workspace/ace_v2_context_router.py`):** Pre-register $H_1$ (*AST symbol-cone slicing + SLA frozen-prefix compilation + cache-sticky Thompson-Sampling routing reduces uncached tokens per task by >=40% and lifts KV cache hit rate above 90% vs. v1 baseline*). Implement `/workspace/ace_v2_context_router.py` (`--selftest` exit 0) and evaluate it on `/workspace/ace_v1_traces.db` and `ace_v2_benchmark_tasks.json`, recording paired CIs and $p$-values in `/workspace/exp1_ablation.json`, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.
- [ ] **Milestone 4.2 — Experiment 2: Speculative Action-DAG & AgentLTL Loop Controller (`/workspace/ace_v2_dag_loop.py`):** Pre-register $H_2$ (*Compiling Read->Edit->Verify into a speculative Cordis-revertible DAG with AgentLTL byte-identical override stopping and validated handoffs cuts turns per resolved task by >=45% without violating Split-B non-inferiority*). Implement `/workspace/ace_v2_dag_loop.py` (`--selftest` exit 0), run the controlled ablation against v1's sequential loop, and save results to `/workspace/exp2_ablation.json`, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.

## Phase 5 — Self-Auditing Meta-Harness & Full Head-to-Head Scientific Paper
- [ ] **Milestone 5.1 — Unified ACE v2 Meta-Harness & Self-Improvement Pass (`/workspace/ace_v2_harness.py`):** Combine `ace_v2_cordis.py`, `ace_v2_context_router.py`, `ace_v2_dag_loop.py`, and `ace_v2_scorer.py` into `/workspace/ace_v2_harness.py` (`--selftest` exit 0) with a `ModularRSI` / `P5` Meta-Auditor that mines Split-A failure trajectories, proposes declarative Cordis config patches, and validates them on held-out Split-B under a strict non-inferiority guard, saving the head-to-head `v1` vs `v2` benchmark scorecard to `/workspace/v1_vs_v2_scorecard.json`, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.
- [ ] **Milestone 5.2 — DeepSeek-Style Scientific Paper & Counter-Evidence Audit (`notes/ace-v2-scientific-paper.md`):** Use `action.type="wiki_write"` to write a complete, publication-grade research paper in `notes/ace-v2-scientific-paper.md` reporting all pre-registered hypotheses, `v1` vs `v2` ablation tables (`95% Beta CIs`, `McNemar p`, `cost-of-pass`, `KV cache hit %`, `turns/task`, `mutant kill rate`), negative findings, and a dedicated Counter-Evidence & Limitations section, then mark `[x]` in `goals.md`.
